verdict.rationale: Figma's first-party Code Connect maps design-system components in Figma to real code, so Dev Mode shows true-to-production snippets from your codebase rather than autogenerated examples, with a React guide and a CLI. The MCP server also turns selected frames into code, kept consistent with the codebase via Code Connect. A community complaint about Dev Mode's autogenerated absolute-positioning CSS concerns the non-Code-Connect fallback and does not contradict the mappings. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that the generated or mapped code ships as-is, and documented framework coverage beyond React.

support.subject: As a developer, designs map to production code — component-to-code mappings or direct design-to-code output I can actually ship

citations.quote: When using Code Connect, Figma's Dev Mode will display true-to-production code snippets from your design system instead of autogenerated code examples.
This guide helps you connect your React (or React Native) components with Figma components using Code Connect.
Code Connect keeps your generated code consistent with your codebase.
Select a Figma frame and turn it into code.
Turn your design into a code-backed prototype, or build it into production with Figma’s MCP server.
